payload.title: GPT 第四轮 Q0-Q6 验证：Q0 成立但平凡；Q1/Q2/Q3/Q5/Q6 在 P2 被经验杀死

payload.scope: GPT round-4 routes Q0-Q6 validation (prior-art + cheap experiments T4-1..T4-6)

verdicts.Q0 linear-prefeedback invariance: CONFIRMED but trivial linear-algebra identity (row-space), not a contribution
verdicts.Q1 FSAKC: KILLED on P2: even full-rank nonlinear drift only -0.25% val RMSE, residual rank unchanged; P1 -31% but = standard input-channel identification; exact case occupied by Fan 2401.08153
verdicts.Q2 FSMO: KILLED: P2 residual block-Hankel rank 90%=78/99%=97 of 100 -> no low-order dynamic realization; D7 'low-rank' was instantaneous covariance only
verdicts.Q3 COMP: WEAK/FAIL: mode placement rho_E best 0.9675, closed-loop rho=1.0; classical eigenstructure assignment
verdicts.Q4 FCH: collapses on P2 (J2<J1 fails because Q1 killed)
verdicts.Q5 SNOK: KILLED: obstruction subspace reproducible (top2-3 <1deg) but full-order dynamics + not feedback-shapeable
verdicts.Q6 CSKC: KILLED: depends on Q1+Q2+Q3, all fail on P2

new_prior_art.Fan et al. 2401.08153: stable/stabilizable Koopman embeddings with smooth prefeedback + generalized feedback linearizability (most dangerous)
new_prior_art.Strasser et al. 2509.02839: Annual Reviews in Control 2026 survey: Koopman control from error bounds to closed-loop guarantees
new_prior_art.2510.05359: Koopman Control Factorization (controller-model joint convex design)

payload.meta_conclusion: After R(18)/N(6)/M(12)/Q(7) routes, none survives the gate; pattern: P2 closure error is small, non-reshapable by feedback, and full-order; P1 residual always in im(B). Diminishing returns under current gate -> C-level direction decision needed.
payload.user_directive: validate + feedback only, do not invent new routes
